preguntas.subtema: De-escalation · CCMA 6I k208 · CMAA 2B k26 · CMA F.1.f / 2027 F.1.f

preguntas.pregunta: A provider charges $100 for a service and the plan's allowed amount is $70. Billing the patient the remaining $30 is called what?
opciones: Balance billing, which a preferred provider may not do for covered services
Balance billing, which any provider may do once the deductible has been met
Coinsurance, which the patient owes as a percentage of the allowed amount
A contractual adjustment, which the provider records as revenue not collected
preguntas.explicacion: Billing the patient the gap between the charge and the allowed amount is balance billing, and the glossary uses this exact arithmetic as its example. A provider inside the network has agreed to the allowed amount and may not bill the difference for covered services, so it happens mostly out of network. Coinsurance is the patient's percentage share of the allowed amount, and the write-off of that gap by a contracted provider is the contractual adjustment.

preguntas.pregunta: What do the two titles of the Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act cover?
opciones: Title I covers health coverage; Title II covers employment decisions
Title I covers employment; Title II covers research participation
Title I covers health coverage; Title II covers genetic laboratories
Title I covers hiring; Title II covers promotion, pay and training
preguntas.explicacion: The 2008 law splits in two. Title I bars discrimination based on genetic information in health coverage, and the Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services and the Treasury write its rules. Title II bars it in employment and is enforced by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission; it took effect on November 21, 2009.

preguntas.pregunta: Which written policies does the OIG guidance say should reach every employee so that concerns are actually reported?
opciones: Confidentiality and non-retaliation policies, given out to all employees
The code of conduct and the privacy notice, given out to all employees
The schedule of consequences and incentives, given out to all employees
The risk assessment findings and audit plan, given out to all employees
preguntas.explicacion: The fourth element is open communication with the compliance officer. preguntas.pregunta: An assistant with five tasks pending walks into a room still thinking about the next one. Which strategy answers that barrier?
opciones: Pause, take a breath and focus on the patient in front of you
Close the door and turn the volume of the television down
Set the lighting to the level that the patient says he prefers
Give the ordered pain relief before starting any teaching
preguntas.explicacion: Lack of attention is its own barrier: it is easy to focus on the tasks instead of the person, so the guidance is to stop at the door, breathe and give the patient your full attention. The other three answers are real strategies for other barriers on the same list, namely noise, light and physiological barriers such as pain.

preguntas.pregunta: The note does not say which side was affected, and the coder reaches for an unspecified code. When is that the right choice?
opciones: When the record does not hold enough detail to assign a more specific code
When the record holds detail for which no specific code has been created
When the provider cannot be reached to be queried before the claim goes out
When the payer's own policy accepts unspecified codes on outpatient claims
preguntas.explicacion: Codes titled unspecified are for use when the information in the record is insufficient to assign anything more specific. Codes titled other or other specified do a different job: they are for use when the record does give detail but no specific code exists for it. Where a category has no unspecified code, the other specified code may stand for both.

preguntas.pregunta: A note states that the skin is superficial to the bones and the brain is deep to the skull. What do those two terms measure?
opciones: How close a structure lies to the surface of the body
How far a structure lies from the midline of the body
How far a structure lies from the point of attachment
How high a structure lies compared with the head end
preguntas.explicacion: Superficial and deep form a pair about depth alone: superficial is closer to the body surface, deep is farther from it. Distance from the midline is medial and lateral, distance from the trunk within a limb is proximal and distal, and height relative to the head is superior and inferior.

preguntas.pregunta: A group practice bills Medicare electronically under its group number but registered for eligibility checks under an individual number. What is wrong with that?
opciones: The eligibility enrollment has to carry the same number used to bill claims
The eligibility enrollment has to carry the individual number of each provider
The eligibility enrollment has to carry a separate number issued by a contractor
The eligibility enrollment has to carry the number of the vendor that transmits it
preguntas.explicacion: The enrollment asks for the individual or group National Provider Identifier, whichever one is used to bill Medicare claims electronically. A practice that registered for electronic claims under its group number must use that same group number when it registers to check eligibility. The vendor or clearinghouse supplies its own unique identifier separately, and more than one of those can be linked to a single enrollment.
preguntas.fuente: CMS, HETS EDI: How to Enroll
preguntas.subtema: Eligibility verification · CMA III.G.3.a (2027 III.G.3.a) · CMAA 4 k58 · CCMA 5E · NCMA EKB 23

preguntas.pregunta: Which administrative safeguard obliges a practice to look regularly at its audit logs, access reports and security incident tracking reports?
opciones: Information system activity review, part of the security management process
Audit controls, the technical standard that makes the system record the activity
Evaluation, the periodic check of whether the policies still meet the standards
Security reminders, the periodic updates sent to every member of the workforce
preguntas.explicacion: Audit controls make the system capable of recording and examining activity; the duty to actually read what it recorded is a different, required specification of the security management process, called information system activity review. A practice can satisfy one and fail the other.
preguntas.subtema: Activity review · CCMA 5 k189 · CMA III.E.1.e · RMA II.B.6.d · CMAA 7A k100 · NCMA 3.5

preguntas.pregunta: Violence by a patient or a visitor directed at staff falls into which type?
opciones: Type II, by patients, former patients or their visitors
Type I, criminal intent with no legitimate relationship
Type III, by colleagues and other members of the staff
Type IV, by someone with a personal tie to an employee
preguntas.explicacion: Workplace violence is classified by intent and by the relationship to the organization. Type I comes from outside, usually with criminal intent; Type II from patients, former patients or their visitors; Type III from colleagues and staff; and Type IV from someone with a personal relationship to an employee.
preguntas.fuente: StatPearls, "Workplace Violence", Introduction

cuerpo: The NHA Certified Medical Administrative Assistant exam has **135 questions: 110 scored and 25 unscored pretest items**, and you get **2 hours and 15 minutes**: one minute per question.

The test plan comes from a job analysis NHA completed in 2021 and has **seven domains**: Foundational Knowledge (10 questions), Communication and Professionalism (21), Medical Law, Ethics and Compliance (17), Scheduling (16), Patient Encounter (21), Billing and Revenue Cycle (11), and Medical Practice Administrative Procedures and Logistics (14).

Notice where the weight is: Communication and Patient Encounter together are 42 of the 110 scored questions. This is an exam about running the front of a practice, and it tests how you deal with people at least as much as what you know about forms.
guia.fuente: NHA Certified Medical Administrative Assistant (CMAA) Test Plan, based on the 2021 job analysis, Rev. 01/22/2022

cuerpo: NHA reports every exam on a **scaled score, and the passing score is 390 out of 500**. NHA does not publish how many correct answers that takes on a given form of the exam.

In 2024, NHA administered **9,390 CMAA exams and 62.68 % of candidates passed**, the **lowest pass rate of any NHA certification** that year. More than one candidate in three did not pass. Do not let the smaller size of the exam fool you into studying less for it.
This app uses **70 % as a study target** on practice tests that follow the seven-domain split. Clearing it consistently means you are studying at the level the exam expects.
guia.fuente: NHA, Pass Rates for NHA Examinations Administered in 2024 (revised 1/8/25); NHA CMAA Test Plan

cuerpo: These are the areas of the official outline and how many scored questions each one gets in a 110-question practice test in this app:

**Foundational Knowledge: 10 of 110** (9 %) · **Communication and Professionalism: 21 of 110** (19 %) · **Medical Law, Ethics and Compliance: 17 of 110** (15 %) · **Scheduling: 16 of 110** (15 %) · **Patient Encounter: 21 of 110** (19 %) · **Billing and Revenue Cycle: 11 of 110** (10 %) · **Administrative Procedures and Logistics: 14 of 110** (13 %).

Every practice test here draws **exactly that many questions from each area**, so it **matches the official content outline**. A practice test that pulls at random from the whole bank does not follow the outline at all, and it hides the areas where you are weak by burying them in the ones where you are strong. The diagnostic uses the same proportions, which is why its result by area tells you something.
guia.fuente: NHA CMAA Test Plan, based on the 2021 job analysis (Rev. 01/22/2022)

guia.titulo: The plan in force: the 2021 job analysis
cuerpo: The current CMAA test plan is dated **January 22, 2022** and is based on the 2021 job analysis. It is the plan NHA still links for this exam, and it is the one this app follows, domain by domain and count by count.
If you find older CMAA materials, check whether they use these seven domain names. Earlier plans organized the exam differently.
guia.fuente: NHA Certified Medical Administrative Assistant (CMAA) Test Plan, Rev. 01/22/2022

cuerpo: Every exam in this app includes questions that do not count. They are pretest (or pilot) items: new questions the certifying body is trying out before using them for real. They are mixed in with the scored ones, they look exactly the same, and **you are not told which is which**.

The practical consequence is simple: **answer every question as if it counts.** Do not burn time trying to spot the experimental ones, and do not let a strange or very hard question rattle you: it may well be one that will never affect your score.

The practice tests in this app have **110 questions and no pretest items**, because there is no point in making you answer questions that do not count. The time limit matches the real exam's time for the scored plus unscored total, so the pace here is slightly more generous than the real thing.
guia.fuente: NHA CMAA Test Plan, based on the 2021 job analysis (Rev. 01/22/2022)

guia.titulo: How the practice tests here are built
cuerpo: Each numbered practice test in this app is a **fixed set of questions**: Practice Test 3 is the same Practice Test 3 every time you open it, and it shares no question with Practice Test 2 or 4. That is what lets you work through them one by one, compare your score with last week's, and finish the set.
The order of the questions, and the order of the four options inside each question, is shuffled every time. You cannot pass by remembering that "the third one is B".

The timer runs at the pace of the real exam. The result screen shows your score against the study target, the time you took, and a breakdown by area, and every question you missed goes into your review list until you get it right three times in a row.

Every explanation names the public document it comes from: an OSHA regulation, a CDC guideline, a CLIA rule, a WHO guideline, a NIH source. None of the questions come from a textbook or from a real exam form.

To be plain about what these practice tests are: they are **not a copy of the real exam** and they are not the questions the certifying body administers. They **match the official content outline** — the areas, their weights, the number of questions and the pace — and every item is written by us from public sources. This app is an independent study aid, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by any certifying body.
guia.fuente: NHA CMAA Test Plan, based on the 2021 job analysis (Rev. 01/22/2022)

guia.titulo: What is free and what is not
cuerpo: Without paying you can do four things. You can answer the first **3 questions of every area**, always the same ones, so that you see what the questions and the explanations look like in each part of the outline. You can take **a diagnostic** — a short test with the same proportions as the real exam that tells you your score by area — and repeat it every seven days with new questions. Every day you also get **five questions** from the whole bank, with their explanations. And you can read this whole guide.

What you cannot do for free is study an area to the end, take a full-length practice test, or review your mistakes. Those are the product, and they are unlocked with a single one-time purchase for this certification, or one purchase for every certification in the app. There is no subscription and there are no advertisements, and there never will be.

The number of questions and the number of practice tests you see on the home screen and on the purchase screen are read from the content itself. They are never typed in by hand, so they cannot promise more than the app contains.
guia.fuente: NHA CMAA Test Plan, based on the 2021 job analysis (Rev. 01/22/2022)

guia.titulo: What this app does not cover
cuerpo: This app follows the national outline published by the National Healthcareer Association (NHA). It does not cover the rules of your state, your employer's protocols, or the eligibility routes to sit the exam (training programs, work experience, documentation). Check those with the certifying body and with your program.

It is not an official product of the certifying body and has no connection with it. The outline is public; the questions and the explanations are ours, written from public sources you can open and read. If you find a mistake, tell us: every report is checked against the source and corrected in the content, without waiting for a new version of the app.
guia.fuente: NHA CMAA Test Plan, based on the 2021 job analysis (Rev. 01/22/2022)
